description: Floating side-panel window (r44.B). Without its own capability the panel webview gets ZERO permissions under Tauri 2's ACL — it can't listen for panel:state, emit panel:action:*, or invoke close_panel_window, leaving the pop-out inert. Scope: events + app invokes via core:default, plus the plugins TranscriptViewer's actions use (copy to clipboard, save-file dialogs, notifications). Deliberately NO shell — the panel never spawns sidecars; main owns all jobs.
